```cardsmith
card:
  system: mini-d20
  card-type: cover
data:
  # The deck's title, large on the front.
  name: Dragonhoard Campaign

  # Cover art as a wikilink; without it the MiNI D20 wordmark stands there.
  image: '[[Deckblatt.png]]'

  # The note's text before its first `##` heading — the back's licences and acknowledgements. `###` headings structure it.
  body: # no sample

  # A small italic subtitle under the title.
  subtitle: A card deck for MINI D20

  # A discreet footer on the front — edition, date, version.
  footer: Edition 1 · 2026
```
